name: South Hams

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: a licence is needed only for HMOs let to five or more people forming two or more households (the national mandatory scheme).
licensing.fee: £446.40 for a five-year HMO licence plus a £144 fit and proper person fee

neighbourhoods.name: Totnes
neighbourhoods.housing: A hilly market town of Tudor, Georgian and Victorian houses, with flats over shops on the high street and newer estates.

neighbourhoods.name: Dartmouth
neighbourhoods.housing: A steep harbour town of period houses, terraces and flats, with many second homes and holiday lets.

neighbourhoods.name: Kingsbridge
neighbourhoods.housing: A market town at the head of the estuary, with Victorian terraces and post-war and new-build estates.

neighbourhoods.name: Salcombe
neighbourhoods.housing: A sailing town where a large share of homes are second homes or holiday lets.

neighbourhoods.name: Ivybridge
neighbourhoods.housing: A town on the edge of Dartmoor that grew with large estates from the 1970s onwards.

neighbourhoods.name: Sherford

housing: South Hams is a rural and coastal district between Plymouth and Torbay, with Dartmoor to the north. Many homes are stone or slate-hung cottages and period town houses in Totnes, Dartmouth, Kingsbridge and Modbury, and a high share in places like Salcombe and Dartmouth are second homes or holiday lets, which keeps long-term rentals scarce. Larger estates are in Ivybridge and the new town of Sherford. Few HMOs need a licence here.
checkinTips: Coastal homes in Dartmouth, Salcombe and the estuary villages: check window frames, outside paint and metal fittings for salt corrosion, and photograph damp in north-facing rooms.
Stone and cob cottages: photograph walls inside for damp, beams and uneven floors, and the condition of any wood burner or open fire.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank and gauge level or LPG tank, and any septic tank or treatment plant cover.
Homes on steep streets in Totnes and Dartmouth: photograph steps, handrails, retaining walls and parking arrangements, which are often disputed.
New-build homes in Sherford and Ivybridge: photograph snagging items, sealant, paintwork and the garden, and note who maintains shared areas.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact South Hams District Council's private sector housing team (shared with West Devon), which can inspect homes and take action against landlords.
